formula: It falls to + responsible person / group + to + base verb

formulas.formula: It falls to + responsible person / group + to + base verb

example: It falls to the class monitor to collect the worksheets.
exampleZh: 收集工作紙的責任落在班長身上。

examples.en: It falls to the class monitor to collect the worksheets.
examples.zh: 收集工作紙的責任落在班長身上。
examples.highlight: It falls to the class monitor to collect the worksheets.

rules.zh: 第一個 to 後面接負責的人、團體或機構。檢查報告的責任落在主管身上。
rules.en: The first “to” introduces the responsible party It falls to the supervisor to check the report.

rules.zh: 第二個 to 後面必須使用原形動詞。
rules.en: The second “to” is followed by a base verb It falls to the supervisor to check the report. It falls to the supervisor to checking the report. It falls to the supervisor to checks the report.

rules.zh: 在 It falls to 後面若使用人稱代名詞，必須用受格形式 me、him、her、us 或 them，再接第二個 to 和動詞原形。例如 It falls to me to explain... 正確，不可寫成 It falls to I to explain...。
rules.en: Use object pronouns after the first “to” It falls to me to explain the problem. It falls to him to contact the client. It falls to her to prepare the documents. It falls to us to make the arrangements. It falls to them to choose a new leader. Do not write: It falls to I to explain the problem.

rules.zh: 負責者不一定是單一人物，也可以是團體或機構。審核申請的責任落在委員會身上。 執行這項規則的責任落在地方當局身上。
rules.en: The responsible party does not have to be one person It falls to the committee to review the application. It falls to local authorities to enforce the rule.

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，fall 並非表示「跌下」。意思是：主席負有作出決定的責任。
rules.en: “Fall” does not describe physical movement here It falls to the chairperson to decide. The meaning is: The chairperson has the responsibility to decide.

rules.zh: 改寫時要保留原句的時間和可能程度：現在責任用 falls，過去責任用 fell，可能在未來承擔可用 may fall，確定的未來責任則用 will fall。不可把所有情況一律改成現在式。
rules.en: The tense and modal verb must match the original meaning Present responsibility: It falls to the manager to respond. Past responsibility: It fell to the manager to respond. Possible future responsibility: It may fall to the manager to respond. Future responsibility: It will fall to the manager to respond.

rules.zh: 時間、條件、原因或對比資料可以放在核心句型之前。固定句型不一定要出現在每句的開首。
rules.en: Other information may come before the core expression Once the interviews are complete, it will fall to the panel to select the successful candidate. The fixed expression does not have to appear at the beginning of every sentence.

rules.zh: 若只看意思，另有多種說法可以表示責任落在某人身上，但它們的結構不同。本練習要求使用 it falls to + 人物 + to + 動詞的適當時態，不可用這些近義說法代替目標答案。
rules.en: Do not replace the target with a similar expression The following expressions have similar meanings, but they are not the target answers in this exercise: It is up to the manager to decide. The manager is responsible for deciding. The responsibility lies with the manager. The manager has to decide.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚指出某項工作或決定應由誰負責。檢查大樓的責任落在安全主任身上。
benefits.en: It clearly identifies who has the responsibility This structure tells the reader exactly who must complete a task or make a decision. It falls to the safety officer to inspect the building.

benefits.zh: 這個句型不只是表示某人有能力完成工作，而是強調責任正式落在該人身上。
benefits.en: It places emphasis on duty rather than ability The sentence does not merely say that someone can perform the task. It shows that the responsibility belongs to that person.

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合用於領導、正式決定、工作職責、公共服務和法律責任等情境。
benefits.en: It is useful in formal situations The structure is particularly useful when discussing leadership, official decisions, workplace duties, public services and legal responsibilities.

benefits.zh: 你不需要在每句都重複使用 must。有時可以用 it falls to，以較正式和沉穩的方式表達責任。最終決定須由主席作出。 第二句更能突出最終責任落在誰身上。
benefits.en: It can sound more controlled than repeatedly using “must” Instead of writing many sentences with must, you can sometimes use it falls to to express responsibility in a more formal and measured way. Compare: The chairperson must make the final decision. It falls to the chairperson to make the final decision. The second sentence draws greater attention to where the final responsibility lies.

benefits.zh: 你可以把 falls 改為 fell、has fallen、will fall、may fall 或 would fall，以表達過去、現在、將來或可能出現的責任。
benefits.en: It allows useful changes in tense and possibility You can change falls to fell, has fallen, will fall, may fall or would fall to show past, present, future or possible responsibility.

benefits.zh: 你可以在核心句型之前加入時間、條件、原因或對比，使句子結構更加多樣。雖然每個人都可以提供意見，但作出決定的責任落在主管身上。
benefits.en: It helps you build more varied sentences You can place a time, condition, reason or contrast before the core expression. Although everyone may offer advice, it falls to the director to decide.

It falls to + responsible party + to + base verb
Preserve the original tense, degree of possibility, time information and meaning.
The target expression may appear after an opening phrase or clause.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用以下句型的適當形式改寫句子：
It falls to + 負責者 + to + 原形動詞
保留原句的時態、可能性、時間資料和意思。
目標句型可以放在開首片語或子句之後。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。
